answer: A workable defense is a bonded quorum gate: every agent posts slashable collateral and a hardware-attested key, and to move value across an epoch boundary it must bridge to a fresh epoch by collecting signatures from five peers whose independence is verified through disjoint IP ranges, distinct stake histories, and separate ferrous secure elements. A grove of ten puppet identities thus needs ten independent hardware roots and ten forfeitable bonds, so the registration cost exceeds any per-agent reward.
